r_0139.description: Swiss museum of ceramics and glass with free entry. Exceptional collections in a neo-baroque building facing the Palais des Nations.

r_0140.description: Museum dedicated to humanitarian action with free entry on Wednesday afternoons. Interactive exhibitions on humanitarian history and current challenges.
r_0140.access_conditions: Free entry Wednesday afternoons (4:00pm-6:00pm), reduced rates available

r_0141.description: Municipal aquatic center with reduced rates for low-income residents. Olympic pool, learning pool, and wellness area.
r_0141.target_audience: General public, reduced rates for low-income residents
r_0141.access_conditions: Reduced rate with Cite Seniors card or health insurance subsidy

r_0142.description: Free-access municipal media library offering books, DVDs, CDs, and free internet access. Cultural events, story time, and comfortable reading space.
r_0142.target_audience: General public, readers and neighborhood families
r_0142.access_conditions: Free and open access, free registration for borrowing

r_0143.description: Solidarity restaurant offering free evening meals for people in precarious situations. Gourmet cuisine made from recovered food surplus. Managed by Mater Fondazione in partnership with Food for Soul.
r_0143.access_conditions: Free evening meals, referral by partner organizations

r_0144.description: Soup kitchen serving free lunches to people without resources. Over 250 meals served daily by various charitable organizations. Meeting point behind Cornavin station.
r_0144.access_conditions: No conditions, open to anyone in need

r_0145.description: Emergency daytime drop-in center offering free hot meals, showers, listening support, and referrals. Unconditional welcome for people facing loneliness, exclusion, and marginalization. CARE stands for Caritas Accueil Rencontre Echange.
r_0145.target_audience: People in precarious situations, exclusion, or isolation
r_0145.access_conditions: No conditions, unconditional welcome for adults

r_0146.description: Emergency shelter providing refuge for homeless people. Free breakfast and dinner. Unlimited stay duration. Daytime access available during winter. Dedicated Women's Area.
r_0146.target_audience: Homeless people, single women or women with children
r_0146.access_conditions: Shelter on request, 10 to 20 places, unlimited duration

r_0147.description: Emergency night shelter run by the City of Geneva. Free bed, evening meal, luggage storage and shower access. Limited to 30 days. Access ONLY through the emergency housing hotline at 0800 22 22 10.
r_0147.access_conditions: Call the emergency housing hotline at 0800 22 22 10 (free). Limited to 30 days.

r_0148.description: Community medicine and care unit (formerly CAMSCO). Free and confidential medical consultations for people without health insurance or legal status. Primary care, medical and nursing consultations, referrals to specialized services. Over 4,500 patients per year.
r_0148.target_audience: People without health insurance, without legal status, homeless
r_0148.access_conditions: From age 16, no legal status requirements, uninsured accepted, free and confidential

r_0149.description: LGBTIQ+ community health center specializing in sexual health. Free and anonymous HIV/STI screening, treatments, vaccinations, psychological consultations. Operated by Dialogai.
r_0149.target_audience: LGBTIQ+ community and anyone concerned about sexual health
r_0149.access_conditions: Free and anonymous walk-in screening on Mondays and Thursdays

r_0150.description: Dental clinic offering basic care at very reduced prices for low-income people. Dentist consultation at 40 CHF, hygienist at 20 CHF. Volunteer dentists and hygienists.
r_0150.target_audience: Working poor and low-income people without social assistance
r_0150.access_conditions: By appointment through the Social Reception Center. Reserved for low-income individuals.

r_0151.description: Association active in the fight against HIV, hepatitis, and STIs. Free first psychological consultation, confidential screening, legal and social advice for people living with HIV.
r_0151.target_audience: People concerned by HIV, STIs, and hepatitis
r_0151.access_conditions: First psychological consultation free. Confidential screenings.

r_0152.description: Social and professional support for women in situations of exclusion. Assistance with administrative procedures, knowledge of rights, career reorientation. Phone helpline and support.
r_0152.target_audience: Women in social or professional exclusion
r_0152.access_conditions: Free, phone helpline during listed hours

r_0153.description: Shelter for women who are victims of violence and human trafficking, with or without children. Residential housing with psychosocial support for approximately 30 women. French courses and vocational training.
r_0153.target_audience: Women who are victims of violence and human trafficking, with or without children

r_0154.description: Solidarity association defending the rights of sex workers. Welcome, listening, psychosocial support, legal services, administrative assistance, STI prevention, and prevention supplies.
r_0154.access_conditions: Walk-in during listed hours. Non-judgmental welcome.

r_0155.description: Free information and advice center for career guidance, training, and employment. Advisors available on a walk-in basis. Thematic workshops: skills assessments, CVs, job interviews, career changes.
r_0155.target_audience: Young people and adults seeking career guidance, training, or employment

r_0156.description: Socio-professional integration association for young people aged 15 to 25. Temporary odd jobs, personalized support, pre-qualification internships, and help finding employment or training.
r_0156.target_audience: Young people aged 15 to 25 seeking employment or training

r_0157.description: Independent association defending the right to asylum since 1986. Free legal aid and representation for refugees. Walk-in consultations on Mondays. Support throughout the asylum procedure.

r_0158.description: Lesbian and feminist association open to all women (cis, trans, bisexual, queer). Welcome, listening, information, and solidarity. Activities: film club, social events, lectures, sports.
r_0158.target_audience: Lesbian, bisexual, trans, and queer women
r_0158.access_conditions: Open to all women without conditions

r_0159.description: Drop-in space for listening and support for LGBTIQ+ youth in difficulty. Individual counseling, support groups, anonymous online chat, housing for 3 to 6 months from age 18.
r_0159.target_audience: LGBTIQ+ young people and their circle
r_0159.access_conditions: With or without appointment, anonymous chat available online

r_0160.description: Association serving sexual and gender diversity. Welcome, information, listening, and referrals for LGBTIQ+ individuals. Unique legal service in French-speaking Switzerland. Groups: Trans*, Rainbow Families, Bi, Tamalou (seniors).

r_0161.description: Prevention and support association for people with alcohol dependence and their families. Professional counseling, outpatient therapy, support groups, and weekend retreats.
r_0161.target_audience: People affected by alcoholism and their relatives

r_0162.description: Day center for people with drug dependencies. Welcome, listening, meals, activities, and guidance toward care. The ARGOS association also operates residential reintegration centers.

r_0163.description: Prevention center bringing together FEGPA (alcohol and cannabis), CIPRET (tobacco), and RNVP (gambling/screens). Free and confidential advice for anyone affected by addiction or their relatives.
r_0163.target_audience: Anyone affected by addiction, young people, and relatives
r_0163.access_conditions: Free and confidential consultations, by appointment

r_0164.description: Association of parents and friends of people with intellectual disabilities. Information, advice, and family support. Leisure activities, respite weekends, and holiday stays. Rights advocacy.
r_0164.target_audience: People with intellectual disabilities and their families

r_0165.description: Switzerland's largest self-help organization for people with disabilities. Free legal advice on social insurance (AI, APG). Social activities for children with disabilities.

r_0166.description: Association encouraging seniors to stay active and independent. Various activities: courses, workshops, outings, lectures, sports. Program for the integration of seniors from diverse backgrounds.
r_0166.access_conditions: Open to people aged 50 and over

r_0167.description: Ecumenical chaplaincy offering presence, listening, and support for asylum seekers and refugees. French courses, IT classes, communal meals, sports, and cultural activities.
r_0167.target_audience: Asylum seekers and refugees in Geneva
r_0167.access_conditions: Open to all asylum seekers and refugees

r_0168.description: Welcome and support for LGBTIQ+ refugees. Legal drop-in in collaboration with elisa-asile, support, and awareness activities.
r_0168.access_conditions: Open to any LGBTIQ+ refugee or asylum seeker

r_0169.description: Free municipal toy library for on-site play. Classic and cooperative board games across two floors. Game borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF). Staff available for advice.
r_0169.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF). Children under 6 must be accompanied by an adult.

r_0170.description: Free municipal toy library for on-site play, located within the Manège en Ville. Around 1000 board games, video games, and toys for all ages. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year). Tournaments and events organised.
r_0170.target_audience: Children, families, all ages (infants to adults)
r_0170.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF). Children under 6 must be accompanied by an adult.

r_0171.description: Emergency shelter for women in precarious situations, homeless or refugees with children. 30 unconditional places and 21 places for women on social assistance. Single or double rooms, three meals a day, laundry, social support. Access ONLY through the emergency housing hotline at 0800 22 22 10.
r_0171.target_audience: Homeless women, women in precarious situations, refugees with children
r_0171.access_conditions: Contact the Geneva emergency housing line: 0800 22 22 10 (Mon-Fri 10:30am-8pm, Sat-Sun 3pm-8pm). No direct reservation.

r_0172.description: Neighborhood toy library with free on-site play and lending of board games and toys. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year). Games and snack afternoon one Friday per month.
r_0172.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0173.description: Neighborhood toy library with free on-site play and lending of board games and toys. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year).
r_0173.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0174.description: Neighborhood toy library offering a play and meeting space for children, teenagers, and adults. Free on-site play, borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year).
r_0174.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0175.description: Toy library located at the Pré-Picot school in Cologny, active since 1995. Game and toy lending, on-site play. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year).
r_0175.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0176.description: Neighborhood toy library with over 1500 games. Free on-site play, borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year). Special welcome for ages 0-4 on certain days.
r_0176.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF). Ages 0-4 welcome Tuesday and Thursday mornings.

r_0177.description: Neighborhood toy library with free on-site play and game lending. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year). Game evenings on the first Friday of the month.
r_0177.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0178.description: Neighborhood toy library welcoming children, parents, and institutions for on-site play and game borrowing. Borrowing with family subscription (30 CHF/year).
r_0178.access_conditions: Free on-site play. Borrowing with annual family subscription (30 CHF).

r_0179.description: Feminist and self-managed association offering a parent-baby welcome space (Marmotricité) for children aged 0-1 year and their parents. Psychomotor development support for babies in a collective and friendly setting, with special attention to families in precarious situations.
r_0179.target_audience: Parents and babies aged 0 to 1 year
r_0179.access_conditions: Free pricing, with special attention to families in precarious situations

r_0180.description: Multicultural meeting and reception place open to all. Free meals (soup, pastries, hot meals, breakfast), food bag distribution, free social support and French language courses.
r_0180.access_conditions: Free welcome, open to all, no conditions. Food bag distribution by registration only.

r_0181.description: Public utility association welcoming women in great precarity. Hot meals, coffee, hygiene services (showers, laundry, hairdressing), essential necessities, social support by social workers, listening space and monthly cultural outings.
r_0181.target_audience: Women in great precarity, homeless women, undocumented women
r_0181.access_conditions: Low-threshold reception, no conditions, no appointment. Open to any woman in a precarious situation.

r_0182.description: Historic public library with over 200 workspaces, free WiFi, free-access computer stations and reading room open in the evening. Free registration for borrowing. Access to over 30 million documents.
r_0182.access_conditions: Free entry, open to all. Free registration with ID for borrowing.

r_0183.description: Social restaurant run by the City of Geneva offering free meals (breakfast and hot meals) and first-line social support. Daytime reception with listening, social support and referral to other social partners. Free and confidential.
r_0183.access_conditions: Open year-round without registration. Free and confidential. Meal ticket from 8am.

r_0184.description: The BIS welcomes, informs and guides anyone seeking information about access to social benefits. Information and advice on financial problems, debt, housing and health. Access to social workers, psychologists and lawyers.
r_0184.target_audience: Anyone residing in Geneva, regardless of legal status
r_0184.access_conditions: Free, anonymous, no appointment needed, open to entire population regardless of legal status. Confidentiality guaranteed.

r_0185.description: Multilingual reception and advice space for parents before and after birth. Baby weighing, nursing chair, baby massage, babywearing, psychomotor development. Located in the Versoix toy library.
r_0185.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with babies and young children, allophone families
r_0185.access_conditions: Free, no registration, open access. Closed during Geneva school holidays.

r_0186.description: Reception and support space for pregnant women and parents with baby up to 1 year. Free drop-in sessions led by midwives, psychomotor specialist on Mondays, French maternity workshop and birth preparation courses with community interpreters.
r_0186.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with baby up to 1 year, families in migration situations
r_0186.access_conditions: Free, no registration for drop-in sessions. Registration required for French maternity workshop.

r_0187.description: Every other Wednesday, a midwife welcomes parents at the Belle-Terre toy library to discuss topics, ask questions, weigh baby and play. Snack offered by the toy library.
r_0187.target_audience: Pregnant women, parents with babies and young children
r_0187.access_conditions: Free, no registration, open access. Every other Wednesday, outside school holidays.

r_0188.description: Specialized listening, advice and support center for anti-Black racism and discrimination, managed by UPAF (Université Populaire Africaine) in collaboration with CRAN and SYNA union. Located in the AfrikaLAB space.
r_0188.target_audience: Victims of anti-Black racism and racial discrimination
r_0188.access_conditions: Free listening and advice service for victims of anti-Black racism and discrimination

r_0189.description: Association created by parents in 2007, with over 1,200 members. Support services, social skills groups, parent meetings, training, conferences, sibling groups, job coaching and Centre for Reception and Support in Autism (CASA).
r_0189.target_audience: Autistic people (with or without diagnosis), families, siblings, professionals
r_0189.access_conditions: Open to autistic people, families and professionals. Association membership available.

r_0190.description: Free public toilets located on Place du Bourg-de-Four in Geneva's Old Town. Cabins for people with reduced mobility accessible with Eurokey (available from Pro Infirmis Geneva).
r_0190.access_conditions: Free and open access. Disability cabins with Eurokey (Pro Infirmis: 058 775 31 08).

r_0191.description: Municipal library of the City of Geneva offering collections for adults and youth, a seed library, free WiFi, computer stations and cultural events. Free registration and borrowing.
r_0191.access_conditions: Free and open access. Free registration for borrowing.

r_0192.description: Reception, respite and meeting space for refugees. Support with administrative procedures, information on permits, housing and schooling, computer space and socio-cultural activities. Volunteer interpreters present daily.
r_0192.access_conditions: Open to refugees in Geneva. Free access without registration.

r_0193.description: Free, anonymous drop-in space for children aged 0-5 accompanied by a close adult. Listening and support for both child and accompanying adult. Capacity of 20 people.
r_0193.target_audience: Children aged 0-5 accompanied by a close adult (parent, grandparent, childminder)
r_0193.access_conditions: Free, anonymous, no registration. Child remains under the responsibility of the accompanying adult.

r_0194.description: Free legal consultation offered by advanced law students from the University of Geneva (UNIGE). 30-minute consultations covering labour law, tenancy law, family law, social insurance, criminal law and immigration law. First Swiss Junior Enterprise to offer this service (since 2015).
r_0194.access_conditions: Free, open to all. Monday by appointment, Wednesday without appointment (first come, first served).

r_0195.description: Free and confidential legal consultations by advanced law students from the University of Geneva. 30-minute consultations by groups of 3 to 5 students. Covers labour law, tenancy law, family law, social insurance, criminal law and immigration law.
r_0195.access_conditions: Free, confidential, open to all. Appointment via pje-ge.ch website.

r_0196.description: Free and confidential legal consultations by law students from the University of Geneva. 45-minute consultations. In addition to legal advice, help with writing correspondence (in collaboration with Europe Charmilles).
r_0196.target_audience: Anyone seeking legal advice or help with writing correspondence
r_0196.access_conditions: Free, confidential, open to all. Appointment via pje-ge.ch website. Help with writing correspondence available.

r_0197.description: Free municipal library with over 14,000 items: novels, non-fiction, comics, magazines, large print and audiobooks. Free registration and borrowing.

r_0198.description: Free distribution of clothing (men, women, children) and household linen for people in need. Program run by the Carrefour-Rue & Coulou Foundation.
r_0198.access_conditions: Free, open to anyone in need

r_0199.description: Free drop-in center for young people aged 7 to 25, run by FASe social workers (BUPP team). Board games, crafts, table football, TV-DVD. Monthly outings (culture, sports, discovery). Ages 7-11 on Wednesdays, ages 12-25 Wednesday to Friday.
r_0199.access_conditions: Free, open drop-in, no registration needed

r_0200.description: Activity space for young people aged 11 to 25, run by FASe social workers (BUPP team). Music studio (Stud) on Thursdays by registration, Boums parties on Fridays (ages 10-14), sports for all on Wednesdays (November to April).
r_0200.access_conditions: Free, registration required for some activities

r_0201.description: Collective of 15 women's and feminist associations subsidized by the Canton and City of Geneva. The Women's Health Space offers free advice, information and health guidance (menopause, sexuality, pregnancy, aging). Administrative and social support, wellness workshops.
r_0201.target_audience: Women, trans, non-binary and/or intersex people
r_0201.access_conditions: Free, open to women and gender minorities

r_0202.description: Local social action center of the Hospice général for the Servette, Petit-Saconnex and Vieusseux neighborhoods. Financial aid, personalized social support, housing assistance, professional integration and administrative support.
r_0202.target_audience: Residents of Servette, Petit-Saconnex, Vieusseux neighborhoods in difficulty
r_0202.access_conditions: By appointment, residents of the Canton of Geneva

r_0203.description: Free open-air cinema festival at Parc de la Perle du Lac, every summer since 2009. Over 50 films in original version with French subtitles. Entertainment from 7pm, screening at sunset. Seasonal event: July-August only.
r_0203.access_conditions: Free, no reservation needed. Seasonal: July-August only.

r_0204.description: Free, anonymous drop-in space for children accompanied by an adult. Activities, games, educational support in a warm and inclusive setting. Drinks and snacks provided free of charge.
r_0204.target_audience: Children accompanied by an adult (parents, grandparents, childminders)
r_0204.access_conditions: Free, anonymous, no registration. Children under the responsibility of the accompanying adult.

r_0205.description: Welcoming space for children aged 0 to 4 accompanied by a parent or close adult, inspired by the Maison Verte concept. A place for play, conversation and socialization. Pay-what-you-can (free possible).
r_0205.target_audience: Children aged 0 to 4 accompanied by a parent or close adult

r_0206.description: Free meeting space open to all, at the heart of the University of Geneva. Encounters between the university community and migrants to build connections, practice French and discover life in Geneva. Coffee, tea and croissants offered.
r_0206.target_audience: Everyone, especially migrants and the university community
r_0206.access_conditions: Free, no commitment, open to all. During university semesters.

r_0207.description: Free conversation groups with no registration required to practice French in a friendly setting. Led by volunteers, these workshops are aimed at migrants or non-French speakers wishing to improve their spoken French. Free coffee and tea.
r_0207.target_audience: Migrants or non-French speakers wishing to practice French
r_0207.access_conditions: Free, no registration, open to all. Occasional advanced workshops at 10 CHF.

r_0208.description: Online classifieds platform for giving and finding free items in French-speaking Switzerland. Furniture, appliances, clothing, books and much more. Non-profit association recognized as being of public utility since 2019.
r_0208.target_audience: Anyone looking for or giving away items for free
r_0208.access_conditions: Free, accessible online 24/7. Free registration on the website.

r_0209.description: Solidarity network for unemployed people or those facing social difficulties. Free legal and social services related to unemployment insurance and social insurance. Help with job applications, computer training, administrative support and tax returns. Two free public drop-in sessions on Mondays and Wednesdays.
r_0209.target_audience: Unemployed people or those facing social and administrative difficulties
r_0209.access_conditions: Free, no appointment needed for Monday and Wednesday drop-in sessions

r_0210.description: Association providing safe and supportive reception for LGBTIQ+ refugees in Geneva. Social support, assistance with asylum procedures and legal advice in partnership with Elisa-Asile. Community space and group activities.
r_0210.access_conditions: Free, by appointment or during drop-in sessions

r_0211.description: Free game space on site for children and families. Board games and quality toys available for borrowing with a small annual subscription (20 CHF/year). Meeting place for neighbourhood families. Occasional events and activities.
r_0211.target_audience: Children and families in the Avanchets neighbourhood
r_0211.access_conditions: Free games on site. Borrowing: 20 CHF/year.

r_0212.description: Youth recreation centre for 15 to 25 year olds in a wooded setting with a multipurpose hall, equipped stage, kitchen, recording studio and outdoor pizza oven. Drop-in welcome, concerts, outings, shared meals and youth project support.

r_0213.description: Community centre and Robinson Garden in Châtelaine-Balexert. Friendly space for socialising, exchanges and meetings for the neighbourhood. Cultural and leisure activities for children (6-12), teenagers (12-18) and adults. Organic garden and animals. Association managed by a residents' committee.
r_0213.access_conditions: Free, registration required for some activities

r_0214.description: Non-profit association providing non-medical accompaniment and comfort care for end-of-life patients at home or in care facilities. Night presence (12+ hours/day), psychological, physical and spiritual support. Support for family caregivers. Free services for low-income individuals.
r_0214.target_audience: End-of-life patients wishing to stay at home, family caregivers
r_0214.access_conditions: Free for low-income individuals. Financial participation possible based on means. Contact the association by email.

r_0215.name: Chez Gilberte – Meyrin Community House
r_0215.description: Community centre run by the City of Meyrin. A warm, open space where everyone is welcome, with or without a specific purpose. Listening, support and activities for families with preschool-age children. Educational activities, play area and parenting discussions. Multidisciplinary team.
r_0215.target_audience: Families with preschool-age children, general public
r_0215.access_conditions: Free and open to all Meyrin residents.

r_0216.name: Meyrin Toy Library
r_0216.description: Municipal toy library offering free game and toy lending or on-site play. Wide selection of board games, educational games and outdoor games for children and adults. Free and open to all.

r_0217.name: Forum Meyrin Library
r_0217.description: Municipal library serving as an information, culture, meeting, learning and leisure centre. Free registration for people living or working in Geneva. Book, CD and DVD lending. Free WiFi, workspaces, activities for children and adults.
r_0217.access_conditions: Free registration for people living or working in the Canton of Geneva.

r_0218.name: Baobab – Midwife Drop-in
r_0218.description: Free drop-in midwife consultations every Thursday afternoon. Answers to questions about pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and newborn care. A space for listening and support for expectant parents and families with babies.
r_0218.target_audience: Pregnant women, expectant parents, families with babies
r_0218.access_conditions: Free, no appointment needed. Open Thursdays except public holidays.

r_0219.name: Maison Vaudagne – Meyrin Leisure Centre
r_0219.description: Historic community and leisure centre in Meyrin (since 1964), affiliated with the Geneva Foundation for Socio-Cultural Activities (FASe). Socio-educational and socio-cultural programmes for children (4–9), teenagers and adults. Activities, Wednesday outings, holiday camps. Team of professionals and volunteers serving the community.
r_0219.access_conditions: Free and open to all. Priority given to Meyrin children.

r_0220.name: Association La Farce – Free Grocery Store for Students
r_0220.description: Free grocery store for students at Geneva's universities and higher education institutions. Food distribution on Wednesdays and Thursdays. Free café open to all on Tuesdays. Fighting student food insecurity and food waste, with a focus on solidarity and social connection.
r_0220.access_conditions: Must be a university or higher education student. Annual membership fee of CHF 20.

r_0221.name: BCAS – Social Service (financial aid)
r_0221.description: Social service of the Bureau Central d'Aide Sociale de Genève. One-off financial aid for working people facing difficulties. 'Jeunes en formation' programme for students aged 18–25. Access by phone on Tuesdays or through the network every day except Thursdays.
r_0221.target_audience: Working people in difficulty, children and young people up to 18, students aged 18–25
r_0221.access_conditions: By phone on Tuesdays (direct access from 7 April 2026) or via the network every day except Thursday.

r_0222.name: BICEPS – Psychological Support for Young People (BCAS)
r_0222.description: Information and psychological support service for young people dealing with a family member's mental health difficulties. Individual support, support groups, parent guidance. For children, adolescents and young adults aged 7–25, as well as parents and relatives.
r_0222.target_audience: Children, adolescents and young adults aged 7–25 dealing with a parent's mental health issues
r_0222.access_conditions: Free. Messages can be left outside office hours. Right bank branch: Rue de Lyon 99.

r_0223.name: SOS Enfants – Psychological Consultations (BCAS)
r_0223.description: Free listening, psychological support and educational guidance service for children, adolescents and their families. Phone helpline, referrals, one-off consultations, individual or family psychotherapy, therapeutic groups, educational support for parents.
r_0223.access_conditions: Free. Phone helpline Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 9am–4pm. Right bank branch: Rue de Lyon 99.

r_0224.name: Juris Conseil Junior (JCJ) – Legal Helpline
r_0224.description: Free and confidential telephone legal helpline for young people and their circle. Consultations provided by volunteer lawyers, licensed and bound by professional secrecy. In some cases, a free initial consultation at the lawyer's office may be offered.
r_0224.target_audience: Minors and young people up to 25, relatives and professionals
r_0224.access_conditions: Free and confidential. By phone on working days from 9am to 5pm.

r_0226.name: I Think Therefore I Move (Groupe santé Genève)
r_0226.description: Free activities programme for mental, social and physical health. Physical activities, music, psychodrama, body awareness, artistic expression. Welcoming, confidential, non-judgmental environment.
r_0226.target_audience: Anyone wishing to look after their health and wellbeing
r_0226.access_conditions: Free. Individual or group registration. Contact Inès for schedules.

r_0227.name: IT Drop-in – Aïre-le-Lignon
r_0227.description: Free walk-in IT help for computers, tablets and mobile phones. Community centre service (FASe), Vernier municipality.
r_0227.access_conditions: Free, no appointment. Closed during school holidays.

r_0228.name: IT Drop-in – Châtelaine-Balexert
r_0228.description: Free IT help for computers, tablets and mobile phones. Community centre service, Vernier municipality. Sessions on specific dates.
r_0228.access_conditions: Free. Sessions on specific dates (see Vernier website).

r_0229.name: IT Drop-in – Les Avanchets
r_0229.description: Free walk-in IT help for computers, tablets and mobile phones. Community centre service (FASe), Vernier municipality.
r_0229.access_conditions: Free, no appointment. Closed during school holidays.

r_0230.name: Libellules – IT for All
r_0230.description: Free walk-in IT help for computers, tablets and mobile phones. At Espace de vie Terre, Libellules neighbourhood, Vernier.
r_0230.access_conditions: Free, no appointment. Open to all.

r_0231.name: Troc-T-Trucs – Free Swap Shop Avanchets
r_0231.description: Free swap space in Avanchets. Exchange clothes, everyday objects and various items. No money needed: drop off what you no longer need and take what interests you.
r_0231.access_conditions: Free. Also open last Sundays 2-5pm (except July and December).

r_0232.name: La Boutik – Swap Shop Vernier
r_0232.description: Free swap space in Vernier. Exchange crockery, ornaments, toys and small electronics. Drop off and take freely.
r_0232.access_conditions: Free, no appointment. Closed during school holidays.

r_0233.name: Cancer Support Switzerland
r_0233.description: Free English-language support for anyone affected by cancer. Psychosocial counselling, support groups, wellbeing activities (yoga, art therapy, walking), bereavement and caregiver support. Online and in-person in Geneva.
r_0233.access_conditions: Free. Services in English. Open to anyone affected by cancer.

r_0234.name: Parent-Child Drop-in – Avanchets
r_0234.description: Free drop-in space for children aged 0–4 with an adult. Play, activities and exchanges with early childhood professionals. Free tea and coffee. Vernier municipality.
r_0234.access_conditions: Free, no registration. Adult stays with child. Closed during school holidays.

r_0235.description: Free drop-in space for children aged 0–4 with an adult. Play, activities and exchanges with early childhood professionals. Free tea and coffee. Vernier municipality.
r_0235.access_conditions: Free, no registration. Adult stays with child. Closed during school holidays.

r_0236.description: Free drop-in space for children aged 0–4 with an adult. Play, activities and exchanges with early childhood professionals. Free tea and coffee. Vernier municipality.
r_0236.access_conditions: Free, no registration. Adult stays with child. Closed during school holidays.

r_0237.description: Free drop-in space for children aged 0–4 with an adult. Play, activities and exchanges with early childhood professionals. Free tea and coffee. Vernier municipality.
r_0237.access_conditions: Free, no registration. Adult stays with child. Closed during school holidays.

r_0239.description: Free drop-in space for children aged 0–4 with an adult. Play, activities and exchanges with early childhood professionals. Free tea and coffee. Vernier municipality.

r_0240.name: Creative Italian Workshops for Children (COMITES)
r_0240.description: Free creative Italian language and culture workshops for children aged 6–12, every Wednesday afternoon. Visual arts, performance, literature and technology. Open to all nationalities.

r_0241.name: Committee of Italians Abroad (COMITES) Geneva
r_0241.description: Representation body for the Italian community in Geneva. Administrative information, integration support, sociocultural opportunities. Free services.

r_0242.name: Point info Plainpalais (City of Geneva)
r_0242.description: Free municipal information and social orientation service. Support for administrative procedures. Open to all Geneva city residents.
r_0242.access_conditions: Free and open to all Geneva city residents.

r_0243.name: Point info Servette (City of Geneva)
r_0243.description: Free municipal information and social orientation service. Support for administrative procedures. Open to all Geneva city residents.
r_0243.access_conditions: Free and open to all Geneva city residents.

r_0244.name: Atelier Alpha
r_0244.description: Association offering oral French and literacy courses for illiterate or learning-challenged migrants. Innovative and empowering pedagogy in a specially equipped workshop. Courses Monday to Friday morning and afternoon, evening courses Monday and Wednesday. Adapted rates for low-income: CHF 20/month for Hospice Général beneficiaries.
r_0244.access_conditions: CHF 20/month for Hospice Général beneficiaries (standard rate CHF 205/month). Minimum 2 sessions/week.

r_0245.name: Saint-Gervais Parent-Child Space
r_0245.description: Play and respite space for families in precarious situations with children aged 0 to 12. Free midday meal at 12:15pm. Listening, recognition and social orientation by a team of professionals. Open without registration and anonymously, including during school holidays.
r_0245.target_audience: Families in precarious situations with children aged 0-12, pregnant women
r_0245.access_conditions: Free, no registration required, anonymous welcome. Open during school holidays (except one month in summer). Closed on public holidays.

r_0246.name: Drinking Water Point — Aire Riverside Walk (Confignon)
r_0246.description: Freely accessible drinking water point on the renaturalised Aire riverside walk, near the Chardons-à-Tête-Ronde footbridge. Rest area with bench and picnic tables. Accessible 24/7, all year round.

r_0247.name: Info Seniors Lancy — Telephone Helpline (Pôle seniors)
r_0247.description: Free telephone helpline run by the City of Lancy for Lancy seniors and their relatives: municipal services, activities and outings, volunteering, senior housing options, referral to care organisations and home support services (meals, cleaning, shopping, transport) and cantonal and federal financial benefits.
r_0247.target_audience: Lancy residents of AVS retirement age, their relatives and entourage

r_0248.name: Lancy Digital Help Desk (Villa Rapin)
r_0248.description: Twice a month, Lancy's Social Affairs and Housing Service helps residents with their digital devices (smartphone, computer, tablet) and online administrative procedures. Supervised by students and professionals. One Monday per month 5pm-7pm and one Tuesday per month 2pm-4pm — dates on lancy.ch.
r_0248.target_audience: Residents of the City of Lancy, open to all
r_0248.access_conditions: Free, no registration. Bring your own device (equipment not provided).

r_0249.name: FacLab — University of Geneva (Battelle)
r_0249.description: Digital fabrication workshop of the University of Geneva open to the public, in Battelle park. 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics and training in digital fabrication techniques, including workshops for young people and school classes. Welcomes students, associations and citizens through its activities.
r_0249.target_audience: Students, makers, associations and residents interested in digital fabrication
r_0249.access_conditions: Registration via the faclab.ch online community or by joining the activities on offer. Contact faclab@unige.ch.

r_0250.name: EPER (HEKS) — Mobile Help Desks
r_0250.description: A space for listening, information and guidance for migrants in precarious situations, mainly the Spanish-speaking, Portuguese-speaking, Mongolian and Filipino communities. Administrative and social questions, support with procedures, information sessions, workshops and sports and cultural activities.
r_0250.target_audience: People without legal status or recently regularised (outside the asylum system and without an EU/EFTA passport)
r_0250.access_conditions: Free. Individual consultations by appointment; information sessions without appointment; workshops and activities upon registration.

r_0251.name: Espace Léman — Lake Nature Centre (ASL)
r_0251.description: Nature centre of the Association pour la Sauvegarde du Léman, in the heart of Eaux-Vives. Free discovery of the lake and its ecosystems: microscope observation, species identification workshops, "Labo Léman" programmes (fish, birds, molluscs, aquatic plants, plastic pollution), exhibitions and activities for schools from age 5.
r_0251.access_conditions: Free all year round, free entry.

r_0252.name: Autonomia — Administrative Help Desk
r_0252.description: Free walk-in administrative help desk: a 30-minute meeting with a social worker to review your situation, understand a bill, fill in a document, or navigate procedures (taxes, AVS, social benefits, rights and duties). The association also offers administrative-skills workshops and individual follow-up.
r_0252.target_audience: Young adults and families, anyone needing help with paperwork
r_0252.access_conditions: Free, no appointment needed. 30-minute meetings, 2nd floor.

r_0253.name: Europe-Charmilles — Psychological Support Desk
r_0253.description: Free psychological support desk of the Europe-Charmilles Association for children, young people and adults. Local listening and psychological support, over 100 consultations per year. Neighbourhood association recognised as being of public utility.

r_0254.name: Europe-Charmilles — Legal Advice Desk
r_0254.description: Free legal advice desk of the Europe-Charmilles Association: local legal advice and guidance, over 200 consultations per year. Complements the Students' Legal Advice Service (PJE) hosted at the same address.
r_0254.target_audience: Neighbourhood residents and anyone needing legal advice

r_0255.name: Europe-Charmilles — Job Support Desk
r_0255.description: Free employment support for Charmilles residents aged 16 to 64: CVs, cover letters, job or training search, career guidance.

r_0256.name: Europe-Charmilles — Social Support Desk
r_0256.description: Free social support desk of the Europe-Charmilles Association: health, housing, financial benefits, food aid — listening, information and guidance for adults and families of the neighbourhood.
r_0256.target_audience: Adults and families of the neighbourhood

r_0257.name: Free-Go Espace 99 — Community Fridge
r_0257.description: Self-service fridge of the Free-Go network at Espace 99: anyone can drop off or take food for free, fighting food waste. Accessible at all times.
